answer_1.quote: Our paper presents experiments on this orthography conversion task with a variety of models, showing that extremely simple statistical models perform better than complex neural models commonly used for other NLP tasks.
datasets: audio transcripts from Kani'āina, a collection of radio and TV programs (Ka Leo Hawai'i and Kū i ka Mānaleo) recorded in the 1970-1980s
answer_1.outputs: Hawaiian text with 'okina and kahakō (Modern Spelling) converted from Traditional Spelling

answer_2.quote: We evaluate models' performance using Word Error Rate (WER) and Character Error Rate (CER).
